text: O2 is the consumer mobile brand of Virgin Media O2 (VMED O2 UK Limited), which describes itself as the corporate brand of the 50:50 joint venture between Liberty Global and Telefónica S.A.
short: O2 = Virgin Media O2, a 50:50 Liberty Global / Telefónica joint venture.

source.name: Virgin Media O2: About us
source.quote: We are the corporate brand of the 50:50 joint venture between Liberty Global and Telefónica SA, and are one of the UK’s largest businesses.
source.note: Undated corporate page; date is the day it was opened. The footer gives the registered entity: VMED O2 UK Limited, registered in England and Wales, no. 12580944.

additionalSources.name: Rugby Football Union: England Rugby and O2 announce renewed five-year partnership
additionalSources.quote: Gareth Griffiths, Director, Partnerships and Sponsorships at Virgin Media O2, said
additionalSources.note: The O2 sponsorship of England Rugby is signed and spoken for by Virgin Media O2 staff, tying the O2 brand to VMED O2 UK Limited.
